Solve the following inequality: \[ {{CT:0}} .\]

generalfeedback:
As \[{{CT:0}}.\]

Then \[{{CT:1}} \le {{CT:2}}\mbox{     and     }{{CT:1}} \ge {{CT:3}}.\]

Hence \[{{CT:4}} \le {{CT:2}}+{{CT:5}}\mbox{     and     }{{CT:4}} \ge {{CT:3}}+{{CT:5}}.\]

\[{{CT:4}} \le {{CT:6}}\mbox{     and     }{{CT:4}} \ge {{CT:7}}.\]

Dividing through by 2 gives

\[{{CT:8}} \le {{CT:9}}\mbox{     and     }{{CT:8}} \ge {{CT:10}}.\]

Taking the 4th root gives

\[{{CT:11}}\ge -{{CT:12}}\mbox{   and  }{{CT:11}}\le {{CT:12}}\mbox{   and  }{{CT:11}} \ge {{CT:13}}\mbox{   or   }{{CT:11}} \le -{{CT:13}}\]

 This is entered as \({{CT:11}}>={{CT:14}} \mbox{   and   } {{CT:11}}<=-1 \mbox{   or    }{{CT:11}}>= 1 \mbox{   and   } {{CT:11}}<={{CT:15}}\)
